The '''Deep Core Security Zone''' was an area of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] which was controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was considered a sensitive region and access to the zone was restricted by the [[15th Deep Core Reserve Fleet/Legends|15th Deep Core Reserve Fleet]], operating out of nearby [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] and was protected by the [[Imperial Hyperspace Security Net]].

Despite [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] being the seat of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] power, evidence seems to point to the Security Zone having always been an easily defended fallback position for the Galactic Empire.

==History==
In the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], hundreds of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the region.
